verdict.rationale: Docs show balance accounts (pooled or per-card), card payment viewing in Customer Area, and a 'Report' webhook type, giving basic visibility into funds and transactions, but there is no explicit documentation of a transaction ledger linking each authorization to its clearing/settlement or of penny-accurate settlement reconciliation reporting. missing for 10: explicit settlement report/reconciliation documentation, auth-to-clearing ledger linkage, penny-level reconciliation guarantees.
